description: Small Mongolian village in Gobi Desert. Site of first completed AI-human collaborative infrastructure project.
significance: Proof-of-concept for SEED-human cooperation. Solar installation achieved 47% efficiency improvement and 60% cost reduction compared to traditional design.

project_details.name: Gobi Solar Initiative
project_details.outcome: First functional demonstration of transparent AI-human collaboration
project_details.design_principle: Local maintainability prioritized over pure efficiency
